name: Venice new branch workflow proof
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - venice/autonomous-workflow-proof-20261109
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/venice-new-workflow-proof.yml
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 3
    steps:
      - name: Download and verify current project instructions
        env:
          PROOF_COMMIT: ${{ github.sha }}
          PROOF_BRANCH: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib,json,os,urllib.request
          url='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SRoyaltyy/checklist-engine/main/TODO.md'
          data=urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=30).read()
          assert b'## Venice' in data
          open('TODO.downloaded.md','wb').write(data)
          result={'proof':'new_workflow_on_nondefault_branch','branch':os.environ['PROOF_BRANCH'],'commit':os.environ['PROOF_COMMIT'],'source':url,'bytes':len(data),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}
          json.dump(result,open('workflow-proof.json','w'),indent=2)
          print(json.dumps(result))
          PY
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: venice-new-workflow-proof
          path: |
            workflow-proof.json
            TODO.downloaded.md
          retention-days: 3
args.message: Prove new branch-only workflow executes without a main merge
